requirements.title: ADJUSTR argument STRING is character
requirements.definition: STRING for ADJUSTR shall be of type character.

pending.string-character-argument: Future source-control plan only: compile a conforming call ADJUSTR(CHARACTER(len=5) :: "AB  ") as the positive control; do not require a diagnostic for a noncharacter argument because this is an unnumbered Clause 16 program restriction.

requirements.title: ADJUSTR result preserves STRING length and kind
requirements.definition: ADJUSTR returns character with the same length and kind type parameter as STRING.

pending.result-same-length: Call ADJUSTR on a length-5 character initialized to "AB#  " and assign to a length-5 result prefilled with "#####"; assert LEN(result)==5 and exact value "  AB#", so length preservation is non-vacuous.
pending.result-same-kind: Call ADJUSTR on a default-character STRING initialized to "AB#  " and assert KIND(result)==KIND(STRING) together with exact value "  AB#"; the value check proves the result was produced by ADJUSTR and the kind check is portable for the required same-kind property.

requirements.title: ADJUSTR deletes trailing blanks and inserts matching leading blanks
requirements.definition: ADJUSTR produces the same string value except trailing blanks are deleted and the same number of leading blanks are inserted.

pending.trailing-blanks-deleted: Call ADJUSTR("AB#  ") into a result prefilled with "#####"; assert exact value "  AB#", so the nonblank sentinel demonstrates that trailing blanks were moved rather than default-filled.
pending.leading-blanks-inserted: Use the same length-5 call and mutate the intrinsic to ADJUSTL or identity; the expected exact value "  AB#" distinguishes the required leading blank insertion.

Classifies ADJUSTR as elemental function; executable obligations for elemental/transformational/inquiry classes are owned by the intrinsic framework, not this descriptive unit.
Example paragraph is illustrative under the Clause 16 addendum; its exact values are cited only as supporting examples for pending plans where Result Value already fixes the result.

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9.8-16.9.14: ADJUSTL, ADJUSTR, AIMAG, AINT, ALL, ALLOCATED and ANINT (batch180). Every unit verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; the ALL plans now use a rank-2 mask so DIM genuinely changes the result rank, the zero-size .TRUE. result has a non-vacuous companion, and the new catalogues assert no review state. Source accounting only.
